en.title: Version 1.0.1
en.content:
**Release announcements**
- Include all delivered changes in Discord release notes, including refactoring, tests, dependencies, CI, documentation and public configuration changes.
- Stop filtering announcements by visible user impact: existing user_impact flags no longer suppress releases with English notes. Every release after the historical 1.0.0 baseline must include an English announcement.
- Publish long notes as numbered Discord messages without truncation, preserving older pending release notes, emoji and code blocks.
- Record delivery only after every message in the batch succeeds, so incomplete announcements remain available for retry.

**Tests and documentation**
- Add regression coverage for technical releases, complete long notes, Unicode, code blocks and retries after partial delivery.
- Update release preparation, contributor instructions and project documentation to explain the complete changelog policy and multipart delivery.
